hard_fail_reasons: The darker grain improves material hierarchy, but the large planes and basic turned leg profile still look like a procedural component model. The approved transfer gate requires more than the current material improvement; the family is not ready for production promotion.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with v002, v003 materially improves the timber color and directional grain, and the integrated room captures retain the full asset at gameplay distance. The finish now has directional grain and a stronger oak-to-walnut distinction, but the top, apron and shelf still use straight-sided components; the turned leg profiles lack the target’s fuller shaping and edge refinement. No stable production incumbent exists, so v003 remains a best-current review candidate rather than a replacement.
next_action_hypothesis: Backlog this asset after its three approved-target attempts. Resume only with a production mesh workflow that authors shaped casework, turned or curved members, credible fitted joints and target-specific proportions; avoid another material-only loop.
